values.note: Electric and water $48, electric, water and sewer $56, tent (no hookups) $40, each plus tax, per tent or RV per night. Payment in full at booking; all reservations non-refundable (a voucher may be issued if cancelled 30+ days out and the site rebooks).

sites.source: https://lostfalls.com/Accommodation ('Sites #1-9 Seasonal Sites'; 'Sites #10-24 and A-K are standard campground sites ... best for RVs, campers, and short-term stays'; 'Sites #25-27 ... tents and pop-ups only'; 'Sites #28-40 ... reserved for tents and pop-ups only'; Group site 1 and 2)

values.note: Book online (Bookmysites) or by phone. Check-in noon, check-out 11 am; arrive by 9 pm or call ahead. One camping unit and 4-6 people per site.

booking.source: https://lostfalls.com/Reservations ('Minimum stays 2 nights Friday-Saturday 3 nights holiday weekends'; 'Check-in 12:00 pm Check-out 11:00 am'; 'please plan to arrive by 9:00pm'; '1 camping unit 4-6 persons per site'; Book Now -> lfalls.bookmysites.com)

note: Family campground on 50 acres along the lower Black River near Black River Falls, with a sandy river beach and canoe, kayak and tube rentals. RV sites line one side of the main road; the river-area sites are for tents and pop-ups only. --Claude
summary: Operator site: $48 W/E, $56 W/E/S, $40 tent (+tax), 26 nightly RV sites + 9 seasonal + 16 tent (~82% nightly), 30/50A, open May 1-Sep 30, Bookmysites, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums. Google 4.6 (228). Passes the price gate at $48. Not waterfront kept.
flags: PRICE GATE (private): cheapest RV night $48 + tax (electric and water, 26 nightly RV sites; prices page current - the accommodation page says the seasonals are 'Full for the 2026-2027 season'). Passes. Not a Good Sam Park (stored false).
GOOGLE: Lost Falls Campground 4.6 (228 reviews), phone (715) 284-7133. RV Life 4.5 stored.
LONG-STAY: 9 seasonal sites (1-9) of 51; 42 sold by the night (~82%). Passes; no wording discouraging nightly guests.

WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' kept: the riverside and 'Beach front' sites (28-40) are tents and pop-ups only; on Esri imagery the RV row along the main road sits about 45-55 m from the Black River through continuous woods. No upgrade.
